retrievalProfile.description: A stark black-and-white composition featuring two silhouettes facing each other with a central void of white negative space and small, widely-tracked red sans-serif text.
triggerTerms: black and white negative space portrait
excludeWhen: busy or textured backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical or square composition where two dark silhouettes (one from the top, one from the bottom) reach toward each other, creating a dynamic 'S' or 'Z' shaped channel of pure white negative space between them. The silhouettes are almost entirely black, with minimal highlights on hair or clothing textures, and are framed by small, centered, widely-spaced red text at the top and bottom margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Figure-ground reversal between black silhouettes and white void
Symmetrical text placement at extreme vertical margins
Contrast between organic human profiles and geometric text alignment
Tension created by the narrow gap between the two dark forms
coreInvariants: Pure black (#000000) and pure white (#FFFFFF) primary palette
Small-scale, widely-tracked sans-serif typography in red
Profiles facing inward toward the center of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale silhouettes occupying the top-right and bottom-left quadrants, nearly meeting in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white negative space channel that draws the eye between the two profiles.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the top silhouette down to the center, then follows the bottom silhouette's profile, punctuated by the text at the margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant white negative space acting as a separator and a shape in its own right.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tones; high saturation for the small text accents.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly black, white, and a single accent color (red)

composition.position: top and bottom margins, centered horizontally
composition.relationshipToImage: placed over solid black areas of the silhouettes

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both top and bottom text to maintain minimalist consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric clarity and clean uppercase forms.
Modern, balanced proportions that work well with wide tracking.
Accessible geometric sans that maintains legibility at small scales.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white image of two people in profile, one coming from the top and one from the bottom, facing each other. The image should be thresholded so there are no grays, only pure black silhouettes against a pure white background, creating a curved white path between them.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in a small, red, geometric sans-serif font. Set the text in all caps with very wide tracking. Center one line at the top margin and the other at the bottom margin, ensuring they are placed over the black silhouette areas.

verificationChecks: Are the silhouettes pure black with minimal detail?
Is the text red and widely tracked?
Is the text centered at the top and bottom margins?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white negative space channel
Amount of texture/detail visible in the hair/clothing
Specific shade of red for the text
mustRedesign: Any grayscale gradients or mid-tones in the silhouettes
Centered text that overlaps the white negative space
postGenerationChecks: Verify text is centered and red
Ensure tracking is significantly wider than standard
Confirm silhouettes create a clear 'S' or 'Z' flow
Check that no text is obscured by the white background
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast silhouette + central negative space void + widely-tracked red sans-serif text at margins.
